Hi Monica,

Quick heads up: Rohan Mehta finished transition to Data Platform as of yesterday (10/17). We need a plan to backfill his SRE II role. Options:
- Promote internally (we have two senior SRE ICs who could step up; would need re-level approval and ~10% comp uplift)
- Hire external SRE II (standard req; 8–10 week TtH)
- Temporary contractor (3 months) to buy time while we evaluate internal candidates

Attached: 20261017-backfill-form.pdf (headcount change form) — contains org code and rationale.

My preference is to prioritize internal movement, then contractor, then external hire. Need a decision on whether we can reuse the existing headcount and any band uplift constraints.

2) Headcount code and org charge (I see org: Infra-SRE, code: CC-3124 on the form).
3) Business impact if we leave the role open for 4+ weeks.

- We have 2 internal SRE IC+ candidates who meet promotion criteria (full infra scope) — can present by EOW (10/22).
